frozen_contract.batching_rule: sorted by (len, hash); BATCH=8; solo if len>1024; shard boundaries at multiples of 8
frozen_contract.layer: final encoder output (the model's returned representation)
frozen_contract.pooling: unweighted mean over real residue/nucleotide tokens, fp32 accumulate

token_layout: per-shard tokens.npy, ragged; use manifests/esmc300m_v1_tokens_index.tsv -> (shard, offset, length)
